notes.title: The Sojourn: A Brand New Update for a Smoother Journey
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

Long time no see. We just wanted to check in to let everybody know that we just released a brand-new update for The Sojourn.

We recently noticed that there were compatibility issues that stopped The Sojourn from running on Windows 11 in some instances. We’ve been working on a fix that’ll hopefully address those issues. We’re always dedicated to making our games as widely accessible as possible and we hope this fix will help future-proof and preserve The Sojourn for next-gen players.

On that note, we’re also currently tinkering with some other ways of bringing the game to new players; but more on that in the future.

notes.title: The Sojourn is NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're excited to announce that The Sojourn is now available on Steam! Dive into a beautiful world where you have to carefully balance light and darkness to solve puzzles and traverse parallel worlds. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33286100/3da902c32f36692aeea49ef6a625afbd4f216b7f.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33286100/65f79db4b9608e7b4afc3275f222fe16a30b2374.jpg

Key features


     Dozens-upon-dozens of challenging puzzles
     Delve into four beautifully crafted chapters, each with their own distinct style and atmosphere
     Banish the darkness in order to reveal the obstacles The Sojourn has prepared for you
     Unravel a captivating tale of light, darkness, and the nature of reality
     An incredible, soothing soundtrack 


If that sounds like something you enjoy, we have some more good news for you. You can pick up The Sojourn at a 33% discount during the Steam launch week!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/794960/The_Sojourn/

Deluxe & Gold editions

Want to dive deeper into the mystical world of The Sojourn? You can with the Digital Deluxe Edition and Gold Pack! Both packs include an early prototype of The Sojourn called Equilibrium, an artbook for said prototype, and an artbook for The Sojourn. The Gold Pack also includes the soundtrack to The Sojourn, composed by the incredible Nemo Ghasemi!

notes.title: Thought Provoking First-Person Puzzle Game ‘The Sojourn’ Coming To PC, PS4 & Xbox One In 2019
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33286100/a7213c480021a503eb6cc865e90f7f00bba26f1e.jpg

Iceberg Interactive is pleased to announce Shifting Tides’ first game, The Sojourn. The Sojourn is a first-person puzzle game in which you traverse parallel worlds of light and darkness in search of answers to the nature of reality. The game is slated for release on PC, PS4 and Xbox One in 2019.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p_8LQK_5u3Y
The Sojourn Story
You are born into a beautiful, pure land, but everything is not as it seems. Darkness seeps through every crevice and forms the foundation of the world you live in. Open your eyes to the shadows of the world to uncover the hidden truth.

Venture into the enchanting world of The Sojourn and face life’s obstacles by solving dozens of unique puzzles that will challenge your perception of your own reality. Take in gorgeous environments as you delve into the game’s four chapters, each with a distinct atmosphere and style.

The Sojourn Key features

 Dozens-upon-dozens of challenging puzzles
 Delve into four beautifully crafted chapters, each with their own distinct style and atmosphere
 Banish the darkness in order to reveal the obstacles The Sojourn has prepared for you
 Unravel a captivating tale of light, darkness, and the nature of reality.

Aspiring sojourners can sign up to the newsletter via the official website, to be notified when the game becomes available. PC gamers will know when the game releases by wishlisting the game on Steam.
